# Real downloaded statistics, not demo performance

Companion fixtures `nflverse-2026-min-tb-plays.csv` and `nflverse-2026-return-sample.csv` contain the 179 reduced-column plays for `2026_03_MIN_TB` and Myles Price's weekly row. Source: [nflverse 2026 PBP download](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/download/pbp/play_by_play_2026.csv.gz), retrieved 11 October Sydney; gzip SHA-256 `e7c162e793cb0f828b97c9c92bf6efd7d60ff35eb6ef9b407b8d16001fd2a39a`. Same nflverse contributor attribution / CC BY 4.0 licence and warranty/rights boundaries below. Docked modifications: match filtering, selected structured fields, removed descriptions/media/other columns. Play 362 explicitly attributes one ordinary punt-return TD to GSIS `00-0040506`; no prose extraction needed. Total 6.00 points under unchanged rules. This tests a supplemental normalizer, not an enabled hosted PBP pipeline.

`nflverse-2026-atl-pit.csv` is a reduced-column extract of the 20 QB/RB/WR/TE rows for game `2026_01_ATL_PIT` from [nflverse week-level player statistics](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/download/stats_player/stats_player_week_2026.csv), retrieved 11 October 2026 Australia/Sydney. Original SHA-256: `bda143a5f21ce606cf62cbf1f2ba832392e9f2cde73a8f733d4bc5d04f1598ff`. Release asset modification: 10 October 2026 15:19:08 UTC.

Attribution: nflverse contributors. [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) under the repository's [data licence](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/blob/main/LICENSE.md). Modified by Docked: filtered sport positions/game, removed unrelated columns, CSV serialization. No endorsement or accuracy warranty. No photos, logos or provider fantasy totals copied. The licence does not confer trademark/personality rights or warrant upstream rights.

The nflreadr-documented schedule dataset identifies the game as Atlanta at Pittsburgh, 13 September 2026, completed score 13–20. This is mapping/completed-match evidence, not verification of every statistic against an independent official gamebook. Four arithmetic totals are manually reconciled in the test and investigation report. Current club membership cannot be inferred from a historical game team.

**No exact end instant is supplied by this CSV.** Unit tests explicitly use a synthetic completion-contract timestamp; that timestamp is not a researched fact. No real competition, card allocation or member result was created. Hosted activation requires separate verified completion evidence and the rights review described in `docs/ZERO_COST_POSTGAME_DATA.md`.


The new nflverse-2026-atl-pit-pbp.json is a projection of 175 plays from the same original PBP SHA above, including the explicit END_GAME marker. It excludes descriptions and unrelated columns. Its source/licence attribution is unchanged. Hosted post-game acceptance now exists; see docs/NFL_HOSTED_POSTGAME_ACCEPTANCE.md. Exact whistle time remains unknown and is not invented.
